_doc: Committed mutation-survivor ratchet for the weekly `mutants` workflow (.github/workflows/mutants.yml, ADR-0031). Each key below is a crate whose surviving-mutant count is FROZEN at `max_survivors`: the sweep fails and opens a tracking issue when `just mutants -p <crate>` reports MORE survivors than the committed number — i.e. a test that used to catch a mutant no longer does. A crate ABSENT from this file is swept report-only (never red) until it is reinforced and given an entry, mirroring ADR-0031's per-crate 'advisory, then blocking once the baseline is clean'. Lower an entry as survivors are killed to tighten the ratchet; never raise one to hide a real regression.

aozora-ffi.reason: Clean after reinforcement (5 killable survivors killed, host lane: 5 -> 0 missed). All 5 were `delete -` on the `AozoraStatus` discriminants (`NullInput = -1` through `SourceTooLarge = -5`): every behavioural test compared a returned code against `AozoraStatus::Variant as c_int`, so flipping a discriminant moved the function's return value and the expected value together and the equality still held. A `status_discriminants_are_abi_stable` test now pins each variant to its literal wire integer (0, -1, -2, -3, -4, -5), which a sign flip breaks — killing all 5. Genuine gaps, not equivalents: the codes are a C ABI stability contract that embedders hard-code. The 1 unviable mutant (`into_owned_bytes -> Default::default()`) does not compile — `AozoraBytes` holds raw pointers and derives no `Default`. See #485.

aozora-extism.reason: Clean: the host-testable `logic` module has 0 missed over its 17 viable mutants, and the `wasm32`-only `plugin` module is excluded. `logic` (`guard_len` boundary, the six `render_*` serializers, `schema_version`) is fully pinned by the existing tests asserting every output is byte-identical to the shared `aozora::json` authority. The seven thin `#[plugin_fn]` wrappers in `mod plugin` are `#[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]`, so on a host sweep they are cfg-dead and every one of their ~49 mutants is a vacuous survivor; the module was split out of `lib.rs` into its own `plugin.rs` and excluded via `mutants.toml` `exclude_globs` (mirroring the pipeline `instrumentation.rs` precedent) so the ratchet counts only real product surface. The 1 unviable mutant does not compile. See #485.

aozora-cli.reason: Clean after reinforcement (host lane, default features: 172 mutants = 126 caught / 44 unviable / 2 timeout / 0 missed). (a) introspect.rs's describe_node / describe_pair / severity / source / sentinel / internal + sentinel_label map enum variants to &'static str labels; each is now pinned by an exact-label assert over every variant, killing both arm-deletion and the "" / "xyzzy" whole-body string replacements. describe_node deliberately routes structural variants (BodyEnd, ...) to a wildcard, so an 'every variant is non-fallback' check would be a false invariant — the exact-label asserts are the correct pin. (b) timing.rs's pure Duration arithmetic is pinned by exact f64 / u64 asserts on fixed Durations (float_cmp allowed with a reason: the exact value is what kills the mutant). (c) main.rs / diagnostics_render.rs / watch.rs / input.rs mutants are killed via seam extraction (fmt #492 precedent): the is_terminal / stdout side effects were pulled into pure seams — classify_err + ErrDisposition, DiagFormat::resolve(is_terminal), explain_hint, watch_target_paths, inspect_reads_stdin, write_banner — unit-tested directly, with the original call sites reduced to thin wrappers whose end-to-end behaviour is pinned by the smoke + fixture_parity integration tests (golden output). Seam extraction grew the surface 162 -> 172 mutants, all caught (net-zero survivors). The 2 timeouts (main.rs run_watched `==` -> `!=`, fmt_watched `delete !`) unbound the watch loop and are killed by the 30s hang-timeout — not survivors, and the ratchet counts only `missed`. Armed at 0. See #485.

aozora-lsp.reason: 27 equivalent / cfg-dead / non-deterministic mutants confirmed after the crate's 232 killable survivors were killed (host lane, DEFAULT features: 1032 mutants -> 259 -> 27 missed across two reinforcement rounds; the re-swept survivor set is EXACTLY these 27, zero stragglers). Swept on default features deliberately: the `internals` feature only gates test/bench TARGETS (proptest `property_invariants`, shuttle `shuttle_doc_state`) which are non-deterministic, so the ratchet's oracle is the crate's own deterministic `#[cfg(test)]` units; matrix row carries no features to match. Categories (each proved un-killable; each enclosing fn also has killable siblings now caught, so NOT `#[mutants::skip]`ped): (a) BOUNDARY-SNAP loops `while i {>|<} bound && !is_char_boundary(i)` — the `>`->`>=` / `<`->`<=` split differs only at i==0 / i==len, where `is_char_boundary(0)` / `is_char_boundary(len)` is always true so `!..` is false and the loop stops regardless: hover.rs:100/108 (snap_to_char_boundary_left/right), rename.rs:235/247 (minimal_diff_edit prefix/suffix snap), linked_editing.rs:95 (char_before_offset), :176 (find_partner_backward floor snap), half_width_emmet.rs:199 (in_slug_context), paragraph.rs:293 (paragraph_byte_ranges hard-split snap). (b) EMPTY-SLICE / LATER-CHECK RECOVERY — the differing case flows into a subsequent guard that yields the identical result: linked_editing.rs:155 (`idx < limit`->`<=`: at idx==len `source[len..]` is "" so `.chars().next()?` returns None, same as the loop exit); completion.rs:222 (`close_end > body_start`->`>=`: at equality `source[b..b].ends_with('］')` is false so the `&&` chain is still false -> same None); rename.rs:203 (`< 0 || < 0`->`&&`: a lone-negative operand the `&&` lets through is re-caught by the following `usize::try_from(..).ok()?`); half_width_emmet.rs:166 (`plen > cursor || plen > MAX_PREFIX_LEN`, both `||`->`&&` and `>`->`<`: an earlier `if cursor == 0 { return }` makes cursor>=1 and every rule prefix is 1 byte == MAX_PREFIX_LEN, so both operands are always false and `||`/`&&`/`<` all evaluate false). (c) LATER-BRANCH RECOVERY in DocBuffer::is_char_boundary — state.rs:189 (`doc_byte==0 || doc_byte==total`->`&&`) and :197 (`local==0 || local==len`->`&&`): the boundary cases the mutant drops are re-answered `true` by the fall-through locate_byte + local/chunk-boundary checks; :192 (`doc_byte > total`->`>=`): `doc_byte==total` is already returned at :189 so the equality case is unreachable here; :256 (`end_char > start_char`->`>=`, apply_within_paragraph): at equality `remove(start..start)` is an empty-range no-op. (d) *1 IDENTITY / ARITHMETIC — document_symbol.rs:187 (`i + 1 == len`->`i * 1 == len` == `i == len`, never true in a 0..len enumerate, so the early return is skipped and the loop's last iteration returns the identical children Vec); parse_cache.rs:657:27 (`w_hi + 1 < line_count`->`w_hi * 1 < ..` == `w_hi < line_count`, always true since w_hi<=line_count-1, and at the w_hi+1==line_count boundary line_to_byte(line_count)==len_bytes() equals the else branch); paragraph.rs:292 (`soft_end.unwrap_or(end).max(start + 1)`->`.max(start * 1)`==`.max(start)`: soft_end is only ever `Some(end+1)` with end>=start, i.e. >=start+1, and the None arm is end>=start+MAX_PARAGRAPH_BYTES, so the floor is always >= start+1 and the `.max` picks the same value). (e) ROPEY one-past-the-end contract — parse_cache.rs:657:31 (`w_hi + 1 < line_count`->`<=`: differs only at w_hi+1==line_count, where the mutant's line_to_byte(line_count)==line_to_byte(len_lines())==len_bytes() equals the strict form's else branch). (f) Default::default() IDENTITY — backend.rs:95 (delete field `range` from oversize_notice's Diagnostic: the explicit `Range{start:(0,0),end:(0,0)}` is byte-identical to the `..Default::default()` fill, `Range::default()`). (g) NON-DETERMINISTIC measured value — backend.rs:560 (`content_changes.len() > 1`->`>=` in did_change: both branches converge on the same rebuilt snapshot/diagnostics; only WHEN the async refresh fires differs, never the final state); parse_cache.rs:381 (delete `latency_us` from the skip-branch ReparseStats: a wall-clock Duration around an O(1) skip that floors to 0us, so no deterministic assert pins it above the constant-0 default). (h) TREE-SITTER re-parse HINT — state.rs:262 (`local.start + new_text.len()`->`* ` for the InputEdit new_end_byte in apply_within_paragraph): the hint only steers reuse; ParagraphBuffer::apply_edit re-parses against the authoritative post-edit rope (chunk_callback(&self.text)), and because the new text extends past the old tree's coverage tree-sitter re-lexes from position 0 and still yields the correct tree. The existing `within_paragraph_insert_reports_correct_new_end_to_tree_sitter` test drives the maximally-divergent case (ruby insert at local.start==0, mutant hint 0*27==0) and the ruby still parses — empirically confirming no observable difference. (i) CFG-DEAD under default features — parse_cache.rs:451 (both `sanitized -> None` and `-> Some(Box::leak(..))`): `ParseCache::sanitized` is `#[cfg(feature = "internals")]`, so under the mandated default-feature sweep it is not compiled and the mutation is vacuous; the fn's real coverage is the internals-gated `rope_src_parity` integration test.

aozora-spec.reason: Two provably-equivalent mutants in Span::shift_clamp — crates/aozora-spec/src/span.rs:105 (`<` -> `<=`) and :107 (`>` -> `>=`). They differ from the original only at `shifted == 0` and `shifted == u32::MAX` respectively, where both comparisons yield the identical clamp, so no input can distinguish them. Deliberately NOT `#[mutants::skip]`ped: skip is function-granular and would also silence the killable `>` -> `==` sibling on the same function. See PR #482.

aozora-syntax.reason: Three provably-equivalent mutants, each a comparison the mutation cannot change on any reachable input. (1) crates/aozora-syntax/src/accent.rs:414 and (2) :463 turn `while i < bytes.len()` into `<=` in decompose_fragment / decompose_fragment_edits: the extra i==bytes.len() iteration calls try_match (None past the end), then `fragment.get(i..)` yields Some("") whose `.chars().next()` is None, so the loop breaks immediately without pushing a char or an edit — output identical. (3) crates/aozora-syntax/src/format.rs:46 turns `self.0.get() > 0` into `>= 0` in FontShift::larger, but the field is NonZeroI8 so 0 is unconstructible and the two comparisons agree on every value. Deliberately NOT `#[mutants::skip]`ped: each enclosing fn also carries KILLABLE sibling mutants (e.g. larger()'s `>` -> `<` / `==`, already caught) that a function-granular skip would silence too. Confirmed 3-missed on both the container and host lanes. See #485.

aozora-encoding.reason: Five equivalent/unreachable mutants in crates/aozora-encoding/src/gaiji.rs, all confirmed un-killable after the crate's other 27 survivors were killed (host+container parity: 225 mutants -> 5 missed). (1) parse_menkuten:520:31 `||`->`&&`: the trailing `mkt.to_string() == token` round-trip guard only accepts input where both operands of that `||` are already false (exactly three parts AND level==plane+2), so `A||B` and `A&&B` are both false on every accepted input and both yield None on every rejected one. (2,3) resolve_at:719:43 `>`->`==` and `>`->`>=`: the guard `body_end > source.len()` is unreachable-true — `source.get(start..end)?` above guarantees end<=len and body_end = end - GAIJI_CLOSE.len() < end, so the clause is always false and all three comparisons agree (an intentional defensive check). (4) snap_to_char_boundary_left:818:15 `>`->`>=`: differs from `>` only at idx==0, where `!is_char_boundary(0)` is always false so the `&&` stops the loop regardless. (5) snap_to_char_boundary_right:826:15 `<`->`<=`: symmetric at idx==len (the end index is always a boundary). Deliberately NOT `#[mutants::skip]`ped: each enclosing fn also has killable siblings (already caught) a function-granular skip would silence. See #485.

aozora-scan.reason: Clean after reinforcement. The two OffsetSink::reserve stubs (Vec + BumpVec impls) are killed by capacity assertions in trait_def.rs. The perf-only `prewarm` (deleting its body only defers the idempotent automaton build — no observable output) and the cfg-dead no_std `scan_into` (not built under the default `std` sweep) are `#[cfg_attr(test, mutants::skip)]`ped with in-source reasons — untestable-by-nature, not hidden gaps. 0 survivors on both the host and container lanes. See #485.

aozora-veb.reason: Clean with no reinforcement needed: every viable mutant in the Eytzinger / van-Emde-Boas lookup layer is already caught by the suite (host + container both report 0 missed). The ~12 timeouts are unbounded-loop mutations of the bounded search loops that the 30s hang-timeout kills — they are not survivors and the ratchet does not count them. See #485.

aozora-pipeline.reason: 39 equivalent/unreachable mutants confirmed un-killable after the crate's 365 killable survivors were killed (host + container: 484 -> 39 missed; enumeration is 1031 not 1111 because the cfg-dead classify-instrument module is excluded in mutants.toml). The re-swept survivor set is EXACTLY these 39 (zero stragglers). Categories: (a) boundary comparisons (`<` -> `<=`, `>` -> `>=`) whose only added case is an empty-slice no-op at cursor==len (sanitize.rs line-ending / decorative-rule / accent walks; mod.rs build_content_from_body at events.end, a non-candidate PairClose); (b) `&&`/`||` swaps over operands an internal invariant keeps always-true (sanitize.rs neutralize_sentinel_collisions — the diagnostics are generated internally on the same buffer so their spans are always in-bounds and char-aligned); (c) arithmetic on `open_idx`, which is 0 at every call site, so `+1` / `*1` / `-` leaves the reading/content window.bytes unchanged and only shifts an event-range start onto a non-candidate event (mod.rs recognize_ruby / try_ruby_emit / try_angle_quote_emit / try_emit_gaiji_at / try_emit_annotation_at); (d) three `#[cfg(feature="classify-instrument")]` counter comparisons in pending_outputs_pop_front, cfg-dead under the default-feature sweep; (e) state writes that are never read after the EOF Unclosed drain, and match-guard/arm mutations over patterns an upstream `!is_empty()` filter makes unreachable (mod.rs handle_stream_event / classify_forward_heading; forward.rs; directive.rs prewarm; pipeline.rs; offset.rs; tokenize.rs). Full per-mutant proofs are in the PR body. Deliberately NOT `#[mutants::skip]`ped: each enclosing fn also has killable siblings (now caught) a function-granular skip would silence. See #485.

aozora-render.reason: 3 equivalent mutants confirmed after the crate's 188 killable survivors were killed (host: 190 -> 3 missed, including one caught->missed straggler `TrackingWriter::last -> None` that the fan-out missed and a direct assertion re-killed). (1,2) walk.rs:89 and :99 replace the WalkSink default methods on_newline / finish with `Ok(Default::default())`; both default bodies return `Ok(())` and `<() as Default>::default()` is `()`, so the payloads are bit-identical. (3) spelling/html.rs:271 `<` -> `<=` in escape_text_chunk: at cursor==pos (the only added case, since cursor is never > pos) the body writes chunk[pos..pos], an empty-slice write_str no-op. Deliberately NOT `#[mutants::skip]`ped: each enclosing fn also has killable siblings a function-granular skip would silence. See #485.

aozora-fmt.reason: Clean after reinforcement (30 killable survivors killed, host lane: 30 -> 0 missed). report.rs's unified-diff hunk_span is pinned by an exact `@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@` header assertion — one test kills all 15 return-tuple replacements plus the 4 line-101 arithmetic mutants because the real span (start 3, length 7) matches none of them; cli.rs's FmtArgs clap accessors (encoding / serialize_options) and source.rs's bounded-stdin read cap (extracted into a `stdin_read_cap` const fn so the previously-untestable `MAX_SOURCE_BYTES + 1` on the 4 GiB `.take()` boundary is pinned to its concrete value) are pinned by direct value asserts; lib.rs's broken-pipe -> exit-0 decision is unit-tested via an extracted `err_exit_code` helper fed synthetic BrokenPipe / other anyhow errors, and the stdout side-effect guards (`--write --list` path listing at :254, `--check --diff` header suppression on canonical stdin at :194) are pinned by subprocess integration tests driving the built binary. 0 survivors on the host lane. See #485.

aozora-cst.reason: Clean after reinforcement (10 killable survivors killed, host lane: 10 -> 0 missed). build.rs's Walker::dispatch_node arms (Inline/BlockLeaf, BlockOpen, BlockClose) and its matched-close `>` guard are pinned by structural assertions on the rowan tree (node kinds, and root-sibling vs nested placement of trailing text) — the pre-existing lossless byte round-trip tests missed them because every mutation preserves leaf bytes; kind.rs's from_raw_u16 arms (raw 1..=6) are pinned by a per-discriminant round-trip that panics on the `unreachable!` fall-through when an arm is deleted. 0 survivors on the host lane. See #485.

aozora-query.reason: Clean after reinforcement (5 killable survivors killed, host lane: 5 -> 0 missed). compile.rs's Parser::expect char guard (`c == want`), read_ident's char-class `||` (which admits `_`/`-` in identifiers, so the previously alnum-only tests missed the `&&` mutant), and parse_kind's name arms (Document / Plain / ConstructText) are pinned by parsing well-formed and malformed query patterns and asserting the exact error variant / SyntaxKind. 0 survivors on the host lane. See #485.

aozora-pandoc.reason: 1 equivalent mutant confirmed after the crate's 15 killable survivors were killed (host lane: 16 -> 1 missed). project.rs:302 `plain_attr -> Attr with Default::default()`: `pandoc_ast::Attr` is the tuple alias `(String, Vec<String>, Vec<(String, String)>)` and `plain_attr` returns `(String::new(), Vec::new(), Vec::new())`, which is exactly the element-wise `Default::default()` for that tuple, so the two returns are byte-for-byte identical on every call and no input distinguishes them. The other 15 (close_container Div emission at mid-stream close, push_content_inlines Content/Segment arms, and the bouten_position_slug / annotation_kind_slug / container_attr enum arms) are killed by projecting documents containing each construct and asserting the exact Pandoc output. Frozen in the baseline rather than `#[mutants::skip]`ped so a future killable mutant introduced into `plain_attr` is still caught. See #485.

aozora.reason: 8 equivalent mutants confirmed after the crate's 103 killable survivors were killed (host lane, `--features schema,query`: 111 -> 8 missed). Swept and ratcheted under `--features schema,query` so the whole product surface is live rather than cfg-dead: the single-authority wire projection (json.rs, `cfg(feature="json")`), its JSON-Schema introspection (schema_* fns, `cfg(feature="schema")`, reachable from the `aozora schema` CLI), and the cst::from_tree convenience wrapper (`cfg(feature="cst")`) all compile; the matrix row carries the identical features so host == weekly. The 8: (1) document.rs:110 `Document::options -> Default::default()`: options() returns `ParseOptions::new()`, itself defined as `Self::default()`, so the values are byte-identical. (2) document.rs:234 `==` -> `!=` in `Document::lex`: the retain drops only `DiagnosticSource::Internal` entries, which the production pipeline never emits (aozora-spec invariant; no call sites of `Diagnostic::internal` outside spec self-tests), so the retain is an unconditional no-op and flipping the policy comparison only changes which policy triggers that no-op. (3) lib.rs:193 `prewarm -> ()`: prewarm only eagerly populates two process-global lazy statics (the SIMD trigger-scan backend and the annotation-classifier Aho-Corasick DFA) — pure warmup with no observable output. (4,5) incremental.rs:798 `>` -> `==` / `>=` in `PieceSeq::diag_straddles`: the guard `if b > total_san_len()` and its `==`/`>=` variants differ only at `b >= total_san_len()`, where diag_straddles(b) is invariably false — finalize's per-piece span-containment `debug_assert` guarantees no live diagnostic's current end exceeds the document length. (6,7) incremental.rs:1037 / 1038 `>` -> `>=` in `inside_directive`: `close`/`nl` and `open` are byte offsets of distinct characters (`］`/`［` are 3 bytes, `\n` is 1), so `close != open` and `nl != open` on every input; the `==`-boundary the mutations touch is unreachable. (8) incremental.rs:1438 `||` -> `&&` in `splice_prologue`: a dead guard — `minimal_balanced_region` (called first, on the same buffer) already `?`-returns None whenever `edit_old.start > edit_old.end || edit_old.end > len`, so both disjuncts at 1438 are always false and the `if` never fires under either operator. Deliberately NOT `#[mutants::skip]`ped: each enclosing fn also carries killable siblings (now caught) a function-granular skip would silence. See #485.
